# Universal Language & Universal Writing System

> Source: https://github.com/Jthora/universal_language
> Author: Jordan Traña (Jthora)
> DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.15050731
> License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)

## Status (2026-08-01)

This project previously claimed its formal signature (Σ_UL: 5 primitives, 4 sorts, 13 operations,
23 theorems) was "unique up to isomorphism" — proven, not designed. A direct audit found the
central proof close to circular, and a from-scratch minimality analysis (standard model theory)
gives a smaller, different answer (2 base types) than the claimed counts. That proof apparatus has
been retired; see `research/wiki-comparison-2026-08.md` for the audit and
`archive/superseded-2026-08/` for the original claims, preserved for historical reference.

## What This Is Now

Two separate things:

1. **Universal Writing System (UWS)** — a constructed geometric notation (5 primitives, 13
   composition operations, 42-entry lexicon), with a working software implementation (`ul-forge/`).
   Judged on composability/learnability/expressiveness, in the tradition of Blissymbolics — not on
   a claim of cosmic necessity.
2. **The Emergence Investigation** — an open, six-phase, falsifiable research program
   (`research/emergence-investigation/PLAN.md`) into whether any mind-independent universal
   semantic structure is real. Not assumed true or false; currently in progress.

## Start Here

- PRIMER.md: **Read first.** Full comprehension document — the four-layer stack, what was retired
  and why, how to read a claim, and four specific hazards that cause readers to absorb false claims.

## Notation Specification (Design Choice, Not Proven Necessity)

Signature (as implemented in ul-forge/):
- Sorts: Entity (e), Relation (r), Modifier (m), Assertion (a) — a design choice; see Emergence
  Investigation Phase 3 for why a from-scratch minimality analysis gives a smaller answer (2 base
  types, Montague's e/t) than this flattened 4-sort notation.
- Operations (13): predicate (e×r×e→a), modify_entity (m×e→e), modify_relation (m×r→r), negate
  (a→a), conjoin (a×a→a, derived), disjoin (a×a→a), embed (a→e), abstract (e→m), compose (r×r→r),
  invert (r→r), quantify (m×e→a, graduated p∈[0,1]), bind (e×a→a), modify_assertion (m×a→a)
- Geometric primitives: Point, Line, Angle, Curve, Enclosure — mapped by design choice to
  Entity/Relation/Modifier/Process/Concept, not by proven necessity (the "Unique Grounding Theorem"
  claiming necessity has been retired — see the audit above)

## Emergence Investigation — Current Findings (Provisional)

- Convergent-mathematics and non-human-semiosis literature reviews are in progress
  (research/emergence-investigation/PLAN.md Phases 1–2).
- Real, checked evidence exists for partial pieces (honeybee waggle-dance geometric encoding,
  Bengalese finch bounded hierarchical syntax) — neither shows full relational-algebra structure
  (negation/quantification/embedding) outside humans yet.
- Working hypothesis, grounded in Peircean semiotics/biosemiotics: meaning requires an interpretant,
  so it can't be a property of dead matter, but may be coextensive with life itself. Falsifiable,
  not yet resolved.

## Experimental Verification

The causal-efficacy protocol (5 pre-registered experiments) exists but is not yet a valid test —
it needs true pre-registration discipline, a matched arbitrary-notation control, and executed
(not just available) blinded scoring before a run counts as evidence. See Investigation Phase 5.
